decision_conditions: The proposed first floor side extension, by virtue of its detailed design, form, siting and proximity to the site boundary would appear visually intrusive, incongruous, overly dominant, result in the creation of a continuous facade of properties, out of keeping with the character and appearance of the host building and the surrounding area of which it forms part, contrary to Section 14 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), Policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD6, DMD8, DMD14 and DMD37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

The proposed first floor side extension, by virtue of its siting and proximity to the site boundary would result in a  sense of enclosure and give rise to an unneighbourly loss of sunlight and daylight and outlook, as perceived from neighbouring properties including No. 196 Elsinge Road, Section 14 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), Policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD8 and DMD14 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
description: Single storey rear to side extension and two storey side extension.
